The people behind the numbers

Neighbors helping neighbors.

At the heart of every delivery is a team of people who believe no one should have to choose between a good meal and getting by. From early mornings to the last box packed, they make this work possible.

“It starts with a box of food, but what we’re really building is a community.”— A Harvest Together volunteer
